items.difficulty_reason: Three equivalent formulations of local quasi-coherence on the affine-etale site: first explains how condition (2) is interpreted (U_affine_etale as the full subcategory of affine objects per Topologies, big-small-etale, and the equivalence X_affine_etale/x -> (Aff/U)_etale of sites induced by x), then applies Descent, quasi-coherent-alternative-small to each restriction, and settles (2) <=> (3) from the correspondence of quasi-coherent modules on U_affine_etale and U_etale. Retained author proof at lines 4818-4842.
